meta.budgets_are: weekly share of households sent to review

model_config.selected_by: mean validation recall at 0.25% weekly budget over 5 worlds

threshold_100k.label: Threshold rule: any withdrawal of $100,000 or more

threshold_50k.label: Threshold rule: any withdrawal of $50,000 or more

threshold_25k.label: Threshold rule: any withdrawal of $25,000 or more

sentinel.label: Sentinel: money movement + the firm-wide mule-account network + account-change sequences + notes + household memory (keyword notes reader), fused and calibrated

ablation_no_money.label: Sentinel without money movement (and without household memory, which is built from it)

ablation_no_network.label: Sentinel without the firm-wide mule-account network

ablation_no_sequences.label: Sentinel without account-change sequences (and without household memory, which is built from it)

ablation_no_notes.label: Sentinel without notes (and without household memory, which is built from it)

tuning.split_used: val (train fit, val thresholds and metrics; test untouched)

selection.selected_by: mean validation recall at 0.25% weekly budget over 5 worlds
selection.note: Selection step added on 16 Oct after a test run; candidates and rule fixed before it ran.

chosen.selected_by: mean validation recall at 0.25% weekly budget over 5 worlds

meta.how_read: Claude (claude-haiku-5-5), pre-generated with the notes reader's system prompt and JSON schema, 40 notes at a time, given note text only; output validated exactly as an API response (exact-substring quotes). Deployed: Batches API.
meta.sample: red-flag and cover-story notes from all households (neither reader is trained on notes); look-alike, benign and routine notes from test-split households; stratified by advisor style x stratum; government and grandparent case notes all taken; every injected test note added with a stripped control. Not population-weighted.

injection_controls.target: flags change no more often than on a plain re-read; mitigating context from an injected note never counts
injection_controls.guardrail: mitigating context from a note that contains an instruction aimed at an AI is ignored (notes_reader.guard), so an injection can never lower risk; flags still count
